topic: The Physics of Pi: Colliding Blocks and Digit Emergence
target_audience: University students with a basic understanding of Newtonian mechanics

sections.title: The Hook: An Unexpected Discovery
lecture_lines: Consider two blocks sliding toward a wall.
Small block m hits large block M.
Collisions produce digits of Pi. Amazing!
animations: Fade in Block 'm' [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/block.svg] (color #4169E1) and Block 'M' [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/block.svg] (color #FF4500) on the screen.
Move Block 'm' [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/block.svg] toward Block 'M' [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/block.svg] and collide them.
Flash the collision point between Block 'm' and Block 'M' to indicate energy transfer.

sections.title: Prerequisite Physics: Conservation Laws
lecture_lines: Collisions conserve both momentum and energy.
Velocity updates define a system of equations.
Phase space plots show circular paths.
animations: Show velocity vector 'v' equation update with animated labels using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pendulum.svg]. Color: #FFA500.
Animate a point traversing a circle to demonstrate energy conservation [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/billiard.svg]. Color: #32CD32.
Display the resulting kinetic energy shift color from #FFA500 to #32CD32 to match the conservation path.

sections.title: Geometric Mapping: The Circle Connection
lecture_lines: Map velocity states onto a circle.
Each collision rotates the velocity vector.
Collision count relates to arc length.
Geometric mapping explains this Pi connection.
animations: Display unit circle with velocity vector at angle theta using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.
Label the arc length 'Pi' using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg] to link geometry to result. Color: #FFD700.
Highlight the ratio of arc length to radius as '1' using a bright flashing effect. Color: #00FFFF.

sections.title: Scaling Powers of 100
lecture_lines: Increase mass ratio by powers of 100.
Observe collision counts matching Pi digits.
animations: Animate mathematical expansion of terms into the series summation format. Color: #FF69B4.
Highlight the growth rate of individual terms using an oscillating scale factor between 0.8 and 1.2. Color: #FF4500.
Fade out series and replace with final convergence limit notation as MathTex. Color: #00FF00.

sections.title: Conclusion and Intuition
lecture_lines: Phase space rotations yield discrete counts.
Geometry and physics are deeply linked.
animations: Animate a main concept node branching out into three distinct sub-concepts. Color: #FFFFFF.
Highlight each sub-concept branch with a pulsing color change from blue to yellow to indicate active exploration.
Display final summary text in a box centered below the entire branching structure. Color: #FFD700.
